[RHIM.1.1] Hydration has three participants. The **compiler** must check that
every hydration target declares its `corr` slot (RHIM.2). The **adapter**
(integrator code behind the call callback) must satisfy the assertion protocol
(RHIM.3). The **engine** must provide the budget gate, the
superseding-correlation sweep, and the series-skip behaviour (RHIM.5), and must
auto-register the builtin schemas (RHIM.4).
